decoded.meaning: ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0031 (tr::schema::not_found) } — the reply the golden core actually builds for a write of any knob RFC-0022 removed (§5.4)
decoded.note: the registered-code identity child is the WHOLE error: assemble_error emits ERROR{VALUE} and nothing else, so the reply does not echo the unresolved knob name. Byte-identical to stream/history-depth-host-only, and that is the point — the answer carries no per-knob detail to tell the two apart.
